versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
controles.livre: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: קַ֤ח אֶֽת־אַהֲרֹן֙ וְאֶת־בָּנָ֣יו אִתּ֔וֹ וְאֵת֙ הַבְּגָדִ֔ים וְאֵ֖ת שֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֑ה וְאֵ֣ת׀ פַּ֣ר הַֽחַטָּ֗את וְאֵת֙ שְׁנֵ֣י הָֽאֵילִ֔ים וְאֵ֖ת סַ֥ל הַמַּצּֽוֹת׃

controles.web: “Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and the bull of the sin offering, and the two rams, and the basket of unleavened bread;
controles.kjv: Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and a bullock for the sin offering, and two rams, and a basket of unleavened bread;
controles.livre: Toma a Arão e a seus filhos com ele, e as vestimentas, e o azeite da unção, e o bezerro da expiação, e os dois carneiros, e o cesto dos pães ázimos;

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֥ת כָּל־הָעֵדָ֖ה הַקְהֵ֑ל אֶל־פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

controles.web: and assemble all the congregation at the door of the Tent of Meeting.”
controles.kjv: And gather thou all the congregation together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
controles.livre: E reúne toda a congregação à porta do tabernáculo do testemunho.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ מֹשֶׁ֔ה כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֹת֑וֹ וַתִּקָּהֵל֙ הָֽעֵדָ֔ה אֶל־פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

controles.web: Moses did as Yahweh commanded him; and the congregation was assembled at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
controles.kjv: And Moses did as the Lord commanded him; and the assembly was gathered together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
controles.livre: Fez, pois, Moisés como o SENHOR lhe mandou, e juntou-se a congregação à porta do tabernáculo do testemunho.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל־הָעֵדָ֑ה זֶ֣ה הַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃

controles.web: Moses said to the congregation, “This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded to be done.”
controles.kjv: And Moses said unto the congregation, This is the thing which the Lord commanded to be done.
controles.livre: E disse Moisés à congregação: Isto é o que o SENHOR mandou fazer.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּקְרֵ֣ב מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶֽת־אַהֲרֹ֖ן וְאֶת־בָּנָ֑יו וַיִּרְחַ֥ץ אֹתָ֖ם בַּמָּֽיִם׃

controles.web: Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.
controles.kjv: And Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.
controles.livre: Então Moisés fez chegar a Arão e a seus filhos, e lavou-os com água.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּתֵּ֨ן עָלָ֜יו אֶת־הַכֻּתֹּ֗נֶת וַיַּחְגֹּ֤ר אֹתוֹ֙ בָּֽאַבְנֵ֔ט וַיַּלְבֵּ֤שׁ אֹתוֹ֙ אֶֽת־הַמְּעִ֔יל וַיִּתֵּ֥ן עָלָ֖יו אֶת־הָאֵפֹ֑ד וַיַּחְגֹּ֣ר אֹת֗וֹ בְּחֵ֨שֶׁב֙ הָֽאֵפֹ֔ד וַיֶּאְפֹּ֥ד ל֖וֹ בּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: He put the coat on him, tied the sash on him, clothed him with the robe, put the ephod on him, and he tied the skillfully woven band of the ephod on him, and fastened it to him with it.
controles.kjv: And he put upon him the coat, and girded him with the girdle, and clothed him with the robe, and put the ephod upon him, and he girded him with the curious girdle of the ephod, and bound it unto him therewith.
controles.livre: E pôs sobre ele a túnica, e cingiu-o com o cinto; vestiu-lhe depois o manto, e pôs sobre ele o éfode, e cingiu-o com o cinto do éfode, e ajustou-o com ele.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֥שֶׂם עָלָ֖יו אֶת־הַחֹ֑שֶׁן וַיִּתֵּן֙ אֶל־הַחֹ֔שֶׁן אֶת־הָאוּרִ֖ים וְאֶת־הַתֻּמִּֽים׃

controles.web: He placed the breastplate on him; and in the breastplate he put the Urim and the Thummim.
controles.kjv: And he put the breastplate upon him: also he put in the breastplate the Urim and the Thummim.
controles.livre: Pôs-lhe logo encima o peitoral, e nele pôs o Urim e Tumim.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֥שֶׂם אֶת־הַמִּצְנֶ֖פֶת עַל־רֹאשׁ֑וֹ וַיָּ֨שֶׂם עַֽל־הַמִּצְנֶ֜פֶת אֶל־מ֣וּל פָּנָ֗יו אֵ֣ת צִ֤יץ הַזָּהָב֙ נֵ֣זֶר הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃

controles.web: He set the turban on his head; and on the turban, in front, he set the golden plate, the holy crown; as Yahweh commanded Moses.
controles.kjv: And he put the mitre upon his head; also upon the mitre, even upon his forefront, did he put the golden plate, the holy crown; as the Lord commanded Moses.
controles.livre: Depois pôs a mitra sobre sua cabeça; e sobre a mitra em sua frente dianteira pôs a placa de ouro, a coroa santa; como o SENHOR havia mandado a Moisés.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקַּ֤ח מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת־שֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה וַיִּמְשַׁ֥ח אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן וְאֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־בּ֑וֹ וַיְקַדֵּ֖שׁ אֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that was in it, and sanctified them.
controles.kjv: And Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that was therein, and sanctified them.
controles.livre: E tomou Moisés o azeite da unção, e ungiu o tabernáculo, e todas as coisas que estavam nele, e santificou-as.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֥ז מִמֶּ֛נּוּ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֑ים וַיִּמְשַׁ֨ח אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּ֜חַ וְאֶת־כָּל־כֵּלָ֗יו וְאֶת־הַכִּיֹּ֛ר וְאֶת־כַּנּ֖וֹ לְקַדְּשָֽׁם׃

controles.web: He sprinkled it on the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all its vessels, and the basin and its base, to sanctify them.
controles.kjv: And he sprinkled thereof upon the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all his vessels, both the laver and his foot, to sanctify them.
controles.livre: E espargiu dele sobre o altar sete vezes, e ungiu o altar e todos os seus utensílios, e a pia e sua base, para santificá-los.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּצֹק֙ מִשֶּׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה עַ֖ל רֹ֣אשׁ אַהֲרֹ֑ן וַיִּמְשַׁ֥ח אֹת֖וֹ לְקַדְּשֽׁוֹ׃

controles.web: He poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron’s head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.
controles.kjv: And he poured of the anointing oil upon Aaron’s head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.
controles.livre: E derramou do azeite da unção sobre a cabeça de Arão, e ungiu-o para santificá-lo.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּקְרֵ֨ב מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֗ן וַיַּלְבִּשֵׁ֤ם כֻּתֳּנֹת֙ וַיַּחְגֹּ֤ר אֹתָם֙ אַבְנֵ֔ט וַיַּחֲבֹ֥שׁ לָהֶ֖ם מִגְבָּע֑וֹת כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃

controles.web: Moses brought Aaron’s sons, and clothed them with coats, and tied sashes on them, and put headbands on them; as Yahweh commanded Moses.
controles.kjv: And Moses brought Aaron’s sons, and put coats upon them, and girded them with girdles, and put bonnets upon them; as the Lord commanded Moses.
controles.livre: Depois Moisés fez chegar os filhos de Arão, e vestiu-lhes as túnicas, e cingiu-os com cintos, e ajustou-lhes as tiaras), como o SENHOR o havia mandado a Moisés.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּגֵּ֕שׁ אֵ֖ת פַּ֣ר הַֽחַטָּ֑את וַיִּסְמֹ֨ךְ אַהֲרֹ֤ן וּבָנָיו֙ אֶת־יְדֵיהֶ֔ם עַל־רֹ֖אשׁ פַּ֥ר הַֽחַטָּֽאת׃

controles.web: He brought the bull of the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the bull of the sin offering.
controles.kjv: And he brought the bullock for the sin offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the bullock for the sin offering.
controles.livre: Fez logo chegar o bezerro da expiação, e Arão e seus filhos puseram suas mãos sobre a cabeça do bezerro da expiação.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּשְׁחָ֗ט וַיִּקַּ֨ח מֹשֶׁ֤ה אֶת־הַדָּם֙ וַ֠יִּתֵּן עַל־קַרְנ֨וֹת הַמִּזְבֵּ֤חַ סָבִיב֙ בְּאֶצְבָּע֔וֹ וַיְחַטֵּ֖א אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְאֶת־הַדָּ֗ם יָצַק֙ אֶל־יְס֣וֹד הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וַֽיְקַדְּשֵׁ֖הוּ לְכַפֵּ֥ר עָלָֽיו׃

controles.web: He killed it; and Moses took the blood, and put it around on the horns of the altar with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured out the blood at the base of the altar, and sanctified it, to make atonement for it.
controles.kjv: And he slew it; and Moses took the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured the blood at the bottom of the altar, and sanctified it, to make reconciliation upon it.
controles.livre: E degolou-o; e Moisés tomou o sangue, e pôs com seu dedo sobre as pontas do altar ao redor, e purificou o altar; e lançou o resto do sangue ao pé do altar, e santificou-o para fazer reconciliação sobre ele.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקַּ֗ח אֶֽת־כָּל־הַחֵלֶב֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־הַקֶּרֶב֒ וְאֵת֙ יֹתֶ֣רֶת הַכָּבֵ֔ד וְאֶת־שְׁתֵּ֥י הַכְּלָיֹ֖ת וְאֶֽת־חֶלְבְּהֶ֑ן וַיַּקְטֵ֥ר מֹשֶׁ֖ה הַמִּזְבֵּֽחָה׃

controles.web: He took all the fat that was on the innards, and the cover of the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat; and Moses burned it on the altar.
controles.kjv: And he took all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and Moses burned it upon the altar.
controles.livre: Depois tomou toda a gordura que estava sobre os intestinos, e o redenho do fígado, e os dois rins, e a gordura deles, e o fez Moisés arder sobre o altar.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־הַפָּ֤ר וְאֶת־עֹרוֹ֙ וְאֶת־בְּשָׂר֣וֹ וְאֶת־פִּרְשׁ֔וֹ שָׂרַ֣ף בָּאֵ֔שׁ מִח֖וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃

controles.web: But the bull, and its skin, and its flesh, and its dung, he burned with fire outside the camp; as Yahweh commanded Moses.
controles.kjv: But the bullock, and his hide, his flesh, and his dung, he burnt with fire without the camp; as the Lord commanded Moses.
controles.livre: Mas o bezerro, e seu couro, e sua carne, e seu excremento, queimou-o ao fogo fora do acampamento; como o SENHOR o havia mandado a Moisés.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּקְרֵ֕ב אֵ֖ת אֵ֣יל הָעֹלָ֑ה וַֽיִּסְמְכ֞וּ אַהֲרֹ֧ן וּבָנָ֛יו אֶת־יְדֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־רֹ֥אשׁ הָאָֽיִל׃

controles.web: He presented the ram of the burnt offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.
controles.kjv: And he brought the ram for the burnt offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.
controles.livre: Depois fez chegar o carneiro do holocausto, e Arão e seus filhos puseram suas mãos sobre a cabeça do carneiro:

versos.hebraico: וַיִּשְׁחָ֑ט וַיִּזְרֹ֨ק מֹשֶׁ֧ה אֶת־הַדָּ֛ם עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב׃

controles.web: He killed it; and Moses sprinkled the blood around on the altar.
controles.kjv: And he killed it; and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.
controles.livre: E degolou-o; e espargiu Moisés o sangue sobre o altar em derredor.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־הָאַ֔יִל נִתַּ֖ח לִנְתָחָ֑יו וַיַּקְטֵ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת־הָרֹ֔אשׁ וְאֶת־הַנְּתָחִ֖ים וְאֶת־הַפָּֽדֶר׃

controles.web: He cut the ram into its pieces; and Moses burned the head, and the pieces, and the fat.
controles.kjv: And he cut the ram into pieces; and Moses burnt the head, and the pieces, and the fat.
controles.livre: E cortou o carneiro em pedaços; e Moisés fez arder a cabeça, e os pedaços, e a gordura.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־הַקֶּ֥רֶב וְאֶת־הַכְּרָעַ֖יִם רָחַ֣ץ בַּמָּ֑יִם וַיַּקְטֵר֩ מֹשֶׁ֨ה אֶת־כָּל־הָאַ֜יִל הַמִּזְבֵּ֗חָה עֹלָ֨ה ה֤וּא לְרֵֽיחַ־נִיחֹ֨חַ֙ אִשֶּׁ֥ה הוּא֙ לַיהוָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃

controles.web: He washed the innards and the legs with water; and Moses burned the whole ram on the altar. It was a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma. It was an offering made by fire to Yahweh; as Yahweh commanded Moses.
controles.kjv: And he washed the inwards and the legs in water; and Moses burnt the whole ram upon the altar: it was a burnt sacrifice for a sweet savour, and an offering made by fire unto the Lord; as the Lord commanded Moses.
controles.livre: Lavou logo com água os intestinos e pernas, e queimou Moisés todo o carneiro sobre o altar: holocausto em cheiro suave, oferta acesa ao SENHOR; como o havia o SENHOR mandado a Moisés.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּקְרֵב֙ אֶת־הָאַ֣יִל הַשֵּׁנִ֔י אֵ֖יל הַמִּלֻּאִ֑ים וַֽיִּסְמְכ֞וּ אַהֲרֹ֧ן וּבָנָ֛יו אֶת־יְדֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־רֹ֥אשׁ הָאָֽיִל׃

controles.web: He presented the other ram, the ram of consecration: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.
controles.kjv: And he brought the other ram, the ram of consecration: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.
controles.livre: Depois fez chegar o outro carneiro, o carneiro das consagrações, e Arão e seus filhos puseram suas mãos sobre a cabeça do carneiro:

versos.hebraico: וַיִּשְׁחָ֓ט׀ וַיִּקַּ֤ח מֹשֶׁה֙ מִדָּמ֔וֹ וַיִּתֵּ֛ן עַל־תְּנ֥וּךְ אֹֽזֶן־אַהֲרֹ֖ן הַיְמָנִ֑ית וְעַל־בֹּ֤הֶן יָדוֹ֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל־בֹּ֥הֶן רַגְל֖וֹ הַיְמָנִֽית׃

controles.web: He killed it; and Moses took some of its blood, and put it on the tip of Aaron’s right ear, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the great toe of his right foot.
controles.kjv: And he slew it; and Moses took of the blood of it, and put it upon the tip of Aaron’s right ear, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot.
controles.livre: E degolou-o; e tomou Moisés de seu sangue, e pôs sobre a ponta da orelha direita de Arão, e sobre o dedo polegar de sua mão direita, e sobre o dedo polegar de seu pé direito.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּקְרֵ֞ב אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֗ן וַיִּתֵּ֨ן מֹשֶׁ֤ה מִן־הַדָּם֙ עַל־תְּנ֤וּךְ אָזְנָם֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל־בֹּ֤הֶן יָדָם֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל־בֹּ֥הֶן רַגְלָ֖ם הַיְמָנִ֑ית וַיִּזְרֹ֨ק מֹשֶׁ֧ה אֶת־הַדָּ֛ם עַל־הַֽמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב׃

controles.web: He brought Aaron’s sons; and Moses put some of the blood on the tip of their right ear, and on the thumb of their right hand, and on the great toe of their right foot; and Moses sprinkled the blood around on the altar.
controles.kjv: And he brought Aaron’s sons, and Moses put of the blood upon the tip of their right ear, and upon the thumbs of their right hands, and upon the great toes of their right feet: and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.
controles.livre: Fez chegar logo os filhos de Arão, e pôs Moisés do sangue sobre a ponta de suas orelhas direitas, e sobre os polegares de suas mãos direitas, e sobre os polegares de seus pés direitos: e espargiu Moisés o sangue sobre o altar em derredor;

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקַּ֞ח אֶת־הַחֵ֣לֶב וְאֶת־הָֽאַלְיָ֗ה וְאֶֽת־כָּל־הַחֵלֶב֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־הַקֶּרֶב֒ וְאֵת֙ יֹתֶ֣רֶת הַכָּבֵ֔ד וְאֶת־שְׁתֵּ֥י הַכְּלָיֹ֖ת וְאֶֽת־חֶלְבְּהֶ֑ן וְאֵ֖ת שׁ֥וֹק הַיָּמִֽין׃

controles.web: He took the fat, and the fat tail, and all the fat that was on the innards, and the cover of the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and the right thigh;
controles.kjv: And he took the fat, and the rump, and all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and the right shoulder:
controles.livre: E depois tomou a gordura, e a cauda, e toda a gordura que estava sobre os intestinos, e o redenho do fígado, e os dois rins, e a gordura deles, e a coxa direita;

versos.hebraico: וּמִסַּ֨ל הַמַּצּ֜וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה לָ֠קַח חַלַּ֨ת מַצָּ֤ה אַחַת֙ וְֽחַלַּ֨ת לֶ֥חֶם שֶׁ֛מֶן אַחַ֖ת וְרָקִ֣יק אֶחָ֑ד וַיָּ֨שֶׂם֙ עַל־הַ֣חֲלָבִ֔ים וְעַ֖ל שׁ֥וֹק הַיָּמִֽין׃

controles.web: and out of the basket of unleavened bread, that was before Yahweh, he took one unleavened cake, and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and placed them on the fat, and on the right thigh.
controles.kjv: And out of the basket of unleavened bread, that was before the Lord, he took one unleavened cake, and a cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and put them on the fat, and upon the right shoulder:
controles.livre: E do cesto dos pães ázimos, que estava diante do SENHOR, tomou uma torta sem levedura, e uma torta de pão de azeite, e um bolo, e o pôs com a gordura e com a coxa direita;

versos.hebraico: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן אֶת־הַכֹּ֔ל עַ֚ל כַּפֵּ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן וְעַ֖ל כַּפֵּ֣י בָנָ֑יו וַיָּ֧נֶף אֹתָ֛ם תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: He put all these in Aaron’s hands and in his sons’ hands, and waved them for a wave offering before Yahweh.
controles.kjv: And he put all upon Aaron’s hands, and upon his sons’ hands, and waved them for a wave offering before the Lord.
controles.livre: E o pôs tudo nas mãos de Arão, e nas mãos de seus filhos, e o fez mover: oferta agitada diante do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקַּ֨ח מֹשֶׁ֤ה אֹתָם֙ מֵעַ֣ל כַּפֵּיהֶ֔ם וַיַּקְטֵ֥ר הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חָה עַל־הָעֹלָ֑ה מִלֻּאִ֥ים הֵם֙ לְרֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֔חַ אִשֶּׁ֥ה ה֖וּא לַיהוָֽה׃

controles.web: Moses took them from their hands, and burned them on the altar on the burnt offering. They were a consecration for a pleasant aroma. It was an offering made by fire to Yahweh.
controles.kjv: And Moses took them from off their hands, and burnt them on the altar upon the burnt offering: they were consecrations for a sweet savour: it is an offering made by fire unto the Lord.
controles.livre: Depois tomou aquelas coisas Moisés das mãos deles, e as fez arder no altar sobre o holocausto: as consagrações em cheiro suave, oferta acesa ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקַּ֤ח מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת־הֶ֣חָזֶ֔ה וַיְנִיפֵ֥הוּ תְנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה מֵאֵ֣יל הַמִּלֻּאִ֗ים לְמֹשֶׁ֤ה הָיָה֙ לְמָנָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃

controles.web: Moses took the breast, and waved it for a wave offering before Yahweh. It was Moses’ portion of the ram of consecration, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
controles.kjv: And Moses took the breast, and waved it for a wave offering before the Lord: for of the ram of consecration it was Moses’ part; as the Lord commanded Moses.
controles.livre: E tomou Moisés o peito, e moveu-o, oferta movida diante do SENHOR: do carneiro das consagrações aquela foi a parte de Moisés; como o SENHOR o havia mandado a Moisés.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקַּ֨ח מֹשֶׁ֜ה מִשֶּׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֗ה וּמִן־הַדָּם֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ֒ וַיַּ֤ז עַֽל־אַהֲרֹן֙ עַל־בְּגָדָ֔יו וְעַל־בָּנָ֛יו וְעַל־בִּגְדֵ֥י בָנָ֖יו אִתּ֑וֹ וַיְקַדֵּ֤שׁ אֶֽת־אַהֲרֹן֙ אֶת־בְּגָדָ֔יו וְאֶת־בָּנָ֛יו וְאֶת־בִּגְדֵ֥י בָנָ֖יו אִתּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Moses took some of the anointing oil, and some of the blood which was on the altar, and sprinkled it on Aaron, on his garments, and on his sons, and on his sons’ garments with him, and sanctified Aaron, his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.
controles.kjv: And Moses took of the anointing oil, and of the blood which was upon the altar, and sprinkled it upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon his sons’ garments with him; and sanctified Aaron, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.
controles.livre: Logo tomou Moisés do azeite da unção, e do sangue que estava sobre o altar, e espargiu sobre Arão, e sobre suas vestiduras, sobre seus filhos, e sobre as vestiduras de seus filhos com ele; e santificou a Arão, e suas vestiduras, e a seus filhos, e as vestiduras de seus filhos com ele.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶל־אַהֲרֹ֣ן וְאֶל־בָּנָ֗יו בַּשְּׁל֣וּ אֶת־הַבָּשָׂר֮ פֶּ֣תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵד֒ וְשָׁם֙ תֹּאכְל֣וּ אֹת֔וֹ וְאֶ֨ת־הַלֶּ֔חֶם אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּסַ֣ל הַמִּלֻּאִ֑ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר צִוֵּ֨יתִי֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר אַהֲרֹ֥ן וּבָנָ֖יו יֹאכְלֻֽהוּ׃

controles.web: Moses said to Aaron and to his sons, “Boil the flesh at the door of the Tent of Meeting, and there eat it and the bread that is in the basket of consecration, as I commanded, saying, ‘Aaron and his sons shall eat it.’
controles.kjv: And Moses said unto Aaron and to his sons, Boil the flesh at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and there eat it with the bread that is in the basket of consecrations, as I commanded, saying, Aaron and his sons shall eat it.
controles.livre: E disse Moisés a Arão e a seus filhos: Comei a carne à porta do tabernáculo do testemunho; e comei-a ali com o pão que está no cesto das consagrações, segundo eu mandei, dizendo: Arão e seus filhos a comerão.

versos.hebraico: וְהַנּוֹתָ֥ר בַּבָּשָׂ֖ר וּבַלָּ֑חֶם בָּאֵ֖שׁ תִּשְׂרֹֽפוּ׃

controles.web: What remains of the flesh and of the bread you shall burn with fire.
controles.kjv: And that which remaineth of the flesh and of the bread shall ye burn with fire.
controles.livre: E o que sobrar da carne e do pão, queimareis ao fogo.

versos.hebraico: וּמִפֶּתַח֩ אֹ֨הֶל מוֹעֵ֜ד לֹ֤א תֵֽצְאוּ֙ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים עַ֚ד י֣וֹם מְלֹ֔את יְמֵ֖י מִלֻּאֵיכֶ֑ם כִּ֚י שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים יְמַלֵּ֖א אֶת־יֶדְכֶֽם׃

controles.web: You shall not go out from the door of the Tent of Meeting seven days, until the days of your consecration are fulfilled: for he shall consecrate you seven days.
controles.kjv: And ye shall not go out of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation in seven days, until the days of your consecration be at an end: for seven days shall he consecrate you.
controles.livre: Da porta do tabernáculo do testemunho não saireis em sete dias, até o dia que se cumprirem os dias de vossas consagrações: porque por sete dias sereis consagrados.

versos.hebraico: כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה לַעֲשֹׂ֖ת לְכַפֵּ֥ר עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: What has been done this day, so Yahweh has commanded to do, to make atonement for you.
controles.kjv: As he hath done this day, so the Lord hath commanded to do, to make an atonement for you.
controles.livre: Da maneira que hoje se fez, mandou fazer o SENHOR para expiar-vos.

versos.hebraico: וּפֶתַח֩ אֹ֨הֶל מוֹעֵ֜ד תֵּשְׁב֨וּ יוֹמָ֤ם וָלַ֨יְלָה֙ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֛ם אֶת־מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת יְהוָ֖ה וְלֹ֣א תָמ֑וּתוּ כִּי־כֵ֖ן צֻוֵּֽיתִי׃

controles.web: You shall stay at the door of the Tent of Meeting day and night seven days, and keep Yahweh’s command, that you don’t die: for so I am commanded.”
controles.kjv: Therefore shall ye abide at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation day and night seven days, and keep the charge of the Lord, that ye die not: for so I am commanded.
controles.livre: À porta, pois, do tabernáculo do testemunho estareis dia e noite por sete dias, e guardareis a ordenança diante do SENHOR, para que não morrais; porque assim me foi mandado.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אַהֲרֹ֖ן וּבָנָ֑יו אֵ֚ת כָּל־הַדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה בְּיַד־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס

controles.web: Aaron and his sons did all the things which Yahweh commanded by Moses.
controles.kjv: So Aaron and his sons did all things which the Lord commanded by the hand of Moses.
controles.livre: E Arão e seus filhos fizeram todas as coisas que mandou o SENHOR por meio de Moisés.
